notes.title: Jumpers League Playtest - Get involved and help shape the game!
notes.notes:
We’re excited to announce that the Jumpers League playtest is now open! This is the perfect time to test the game, explore its mechanics, and give us your feedback. Your input will be essential in making the game even better!

Join now for a chance to directly influence the evolution of Jumpers League! We look forward to hearing your feedback.
